subject: Request: Maintainer cohort resource top-up for July hack sprint
messages:
From: Kai Park <kai@openframe.dev>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Maintainer cohort resource top-up for July hack sprint

Hi Mateo,

Hope you are well. OpenFrame is running our Maintainer Sprint from July 10-17 where we expect ~25 maintainers to run hands-on sessions and sprints. The pilot you supported in April went great and we burned through the initial promo quota faster than anticipated.

Quick ask: could Redwood provide a top-up of promotional compute/credits for the cohort (we estimate ~40k token units across the event) and extend the trial expiry for this cohort to July 31 so maintainers can continue testing post-event? If possible, wed also like the top-up applied to the same project id we used in April.

I attached the cohort plan and expected usage breakout. Happy to hop on a 20 minute call if youd like to go over details.

Thanks for considering — you folks were instrumental last time.

Best,
Kai Park
Founder, OpenFrame Labs
kai@openframe.dev

Attachment: cohort-plan.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Kai Park <kai@openframe.dev>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Maintainer cohort resource top-up for July hack sprint

Kai,

Thanks for the note and the plan. Really glad April was successful. I looped in Lauren (manager, partner ops) and Avery (community programs) to confirm approval and any billing constraints.

Initial idea: we can provision a temporary promotional top-up bucket for the cohort and extend the trial for the project to 2027-07-31 while the events are ongoing. I have a small internal request form attached so we can capture the project id and accounting tags.

Can you confirm:
- The project id to apply credits to
- A single point-of-contact during the event for usage questions
- Whether you need the entire 40k up front or a staged release (we can do initial 20k then review metrics mid-event)

I have asked Lauren to weigh in on the exact amount and whether we need a brief monitoring window after the event.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Partnerships, Developer Programs
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: promo_request_form.docx (stub)

Thanks for the summary, Mateo — this aligns with our partner programs priorities. Approved: we will authorize a 20,000-unit promotional top-up today and extend the trial to 2027-07-31 for the listed project.

Conditions:
- Provide the project id and point-of-contact by EOD Monday 2027-06-07.
- We will release the remaining 20k contingent on mid-event usage review (quick check on July 13).
- Finance please flag this under OPP-2027-0431 and confirm the accounting tags.

Avery, please add the HubSpot link and update the partner record. Mateo, once finance confirms, push the credits and send the confirmation to Kai.

Lauren Bishop
Head, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Hi Kai — good news. Lauren approved a 20,000-unit promo top-up and the trial expiry has been extended to 2027-07-31 for the project you used in April. We have recorded this under OPP-2027-0431 and finance is tagged on the HubSpot record (link below).

What weve done:
- Applied 20,000 promo units to project id: OFL-MAINT-2027 (please confirm this is the one)
- Set trial expiry: 2027-07-31
- Scheduled a mid-event check on 2027-07-13 to review usage and decide on releasing the second tranche of 20k

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the project id and point-of-contact (email and mobile).
2) Share a short usage checklist from your side during the event so we can prioritize release if you are on track.

Attachment: MAINTAINER_WORKFLOW.pdf (event checklist stub)

If you want, we can schedule a 15 minute sync next week to walk through the monitoring plan. Thanks again and excited to support the cohort.

Best,
